mapper.select: SELECT s.schedule_id AS scheduleId, m.item_name AS name, TO_CHAR(s.scheduled_at, 'HH24:MI') AS time, 'regular' AS type, s.taken_at AS takenAt, 1 AS alarmEnabled FROM schedules s JOIN medications m ON s.medication_id = m.medication_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND TRUNC(s.scheduled_at) = TO_DATE(#{date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY s.scheduled_at ASC
SELECT medication_id AS "medicationId", item_name AS "itemName" FROM medications WHERE item_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' AND ROWNUM <= 15

SELECT TO_CHAR(s.scheduled_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "scheduleDate", 0 AS "hasPrescription", 1 AS "hasRegular", 0 AS "hasSupplement" FROM schedules s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND TO_CHAR(s.scheduled_at, 'YYYY-MM') = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(s.scheduled_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedules ( user_id, medication_id, scheduled_at, taken_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{medicationId}, TO_DATE(#{scheduledDate} || ' ' || #{scheduledTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), NULL )
